name: Roselle Hunt
description:
About This Game

Welcome to the modular city! Your mission - track down ROSELLE, the runaway thief. You’ve got a massive arsenal of relics from ages past to crush your enemies. Mix and match items, discover insane synergies, and obliterate your opponents.

Unique Characters in Asynchronous PvP

Step into the filthy shoes of one of five despicable adventurers whose ambitions have long since ditched morality and ethics. Every move you make spawns a ghost that another player will have to face. And you'll be up against their ghosts. Then your ghosts will go on to torment even more players. It's a vicious cycle.

Endless ways to mix and match synergies

Stack all sorts of junk in your inventory and watch how it interacts. Some things weaken, some things boost... Experiment, discover, and push the game to its limits!

600+ unique items

600+ items for every taste! Grab whatever you like – your only limits are your imagination, your backpack space, and, well... your gold.

300+ super badass perks

Hundreds of unique perks that can flip the game and your build at any moment! Or just turn everything into a hellstorm of effects. It's all in your hands.

Key Features

  • Asynchronous PvP

  • Ranked Arena mode and Story Hunt

  • 5+ characters

  • 600+ items with unique synergies

  • 280+ perks to boost your synergies

  • Deeply synergistic item system with exponential combo potential.

  • Nasty thief Roselle

FIND ROSELLE

JOIN the grand hunt for the runaway thief! We only care about results, so leave your morals at the door. WE. NEED. ROSELLE. And whatever she stole, obviously.
short_desc: Step into the shoes of a bounty hunter in a PvPvE backpack auto-battler. Combine and upgrade gear, obliterate your foes, and... Find Roselle.
